name: beyond_list_checkpoints
description: List recent job checkpoints; overall status snapshots are included only on the first two returned checkpoints. Set include_changes=true to include records matching each CP_AT. Each record has action=insert/update/delete. ACTION describes checkpoint start/end existence, not just the last operation: insert then update stays insert, insert then delete removes the record, delete then reinsert of an existing node becomes update. deleted is action==delete. node_json contains only the matching newData node for insert/update or the deleted oldData node for delete. node_values is no longer stored or returned. Changes after a checkpoint belong to that checkpoint. No legacy ACTION backfill is provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of checkpoints to fetch, newest first.

include_json_content.description: When false, omit duplicated JSON from text content and rely on structuredContent.
